children.author: shakewingo
NotAnOtter
children.text:
As models get better and better at doing the stuff users are asking it do to, the more and more they trust it and grant it increased privileges.

Back when AI was new, I needed to check every single output because it was 50/50 on the code being complete junk. Now 99% it's correct first time and 1% close but needs some tweaking. I'm lazier and lazier WRT granting permissions and just trusting it to go nuts.

I bet it's just one of the prompt injections that lots of AI models exists nowadays. There are some of them that we don't realize yet. The safety and alignment problem is getting more and more important as model capability increases.
